meta.title: DA NANG Best Places to go with Kids and Families  / 🇻🇳 Vietnam Travel Guide & Vlog
meta.description:
Today marks our 7th day in Vietnam, and we've landed in Da Nang, a city that’s left us truly captivated. 

We already explored 3 vibrant cities during our first week in Vietnam. Our adventure began in Hanoi, where we dove into the bustling streets, continued to the stunning Halong Bay...

Discover Halong Bay: Cruise & Land Adventures with Kids // 🇻🇳 Vietnam 2023 Travel Vlog
https://youtu.be/rkfYmudgtzM

...and soaked in the serene beauty of Ninh Binh's countryside. Ninh Binh enchanted us with its natural wonders, including the Hang Mua peak...
Amazing Ninh Binh: Hiking Hang Mua with Kids / 🇻🇳 Vietnam 2023 Travel Vlog
https://youtu.be/n_droyW0UTw

...the scenic Trang An boat tour...
Scenic TRANG AN Boat Tour in VIETNAM with kids in Ninh Binh is a MUST / 🇻🇳 Vietnam 2023 Travel Vlog
https://youtu.be/L85Bns9HzBw

...and the historic Bai Dinh temple.
Beautiful BAI DINH Pagoda in Ninh Binh, VIETNAM with kids / 🇻🇳 Vietnam 2023 Travel Vlog
https://youtu.be/mJx7gf8wPp4

Arriving in Da Nang, we were awed by its modern charm. Da Nang is often reminiscent of Tokyo, Japan, but also with beautiful beaches, an exciting amusement park, and historic sights, all rolled into one. To savor every moment of this lively city, we decided to splurge a little and booked a luxurious five-star hotel right in the heart of the action so that we can show you everything Da Nang has to offer. Come wander with us as we take you on a whirlwind tour of Da Nang, showcasing its top attractions and must-see experiences.
